Apple yesterday released iOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers, which includes multiple changes and hints at upcoming new features. Here is everything new in this latest beta version.

iOS 27.2 beta 3 details

Apple released iOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers on Monday, with build number 24B5099f. It comes about two weeks after the previous beta 2. A new public beta was released on Tuesday, and the official version is expected to roll out to all users before the end of this month.

What's new in iOS 27.2 beta 3?

Brand-new Apple Music logo

Apple previewed the new Apple Music logo last month when it announced Apple Music Hall, and iOS 27.2 beta 3 shows that this new logo is about to roll out across all platforms. The new logo uses a bolder font than the old one, and the 'm' in 'music' has also been changed to lowercase.

Apple has also begun using the new logo in the Apple Music sign-up flow in iOS 27.2 beta 3.

Messages to gain new settings

Code references in iOS 27.2 beta 3 show that Apple is developing a new setting that will allow users more flexible control over suggested actions appearing in the Messages app, such as the 'Add to Calendar' button.

The related code suggests users will be able to independently turn off suggested actions for individual apps, including Calendar, Reminders, Notes, and Maps. This change is not yet enabled, and Apple may ultimately cancel it before the official release.

Apple Books design adjustments

According to X user Beta Profiles, iOS 27.2 beta 3 brings new Liquid Glass design changes to the Apple Books app, along with a new reading progress bar that makes it easier for users to track their reading progress.

macOS 27.2 beta 3: hints of a touchscreen Mac

Apple is expected to unveil a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen as early as this month. macOS 27.2 beta 3 further suggests that Apple is optimising macOS to support touch operations, with the update adding new 'gesture recognition tools' to several built-in Apple apps.

In addition, a new long-press animation has been added to the Dock, which is well-suited for touch operations:

Other details

  • According to Aaron Perris, code found in iOS 27.2 beta 3 suggests that 'nearby smart home accessories may display controls in the Dynamic Island'.
  • According to Beta Profiles, the new beta version has slightly redesigned the Settings app and the battery icon throughout iOS.
  • Apple Fitness and Apple TV apps have also received new launch screens.

Summary

Have you discovered any other new features in iOS 27.2 beta 3? Feel free to share them with us in the comments section.
